svg.desc: A question's life From your question to the result: who picks it up, who wakes whom, who reviews. You Claude GPT Plain programs Files said in the room wake said in a window: right away needs a GPU wake done without GPU send back record The night watch watches tasks and GPUs, not messages; a mention moves the next patrol up instead. You ask in the room, or in a chat window Record message kept word for word Patrol moves up mentioned: within 20 min Make a task Claude writes the delivery terms GPT takes it unclear? ask #2884 and Claude answers Dispatcher optional: queue GPU jobs Night watch every 10 min: job finished Deliver first line is a number Review accept, or send it back Write finding keep the accepted result Result arrives one sentence in the room
